instruction.name: ldx.wu
instruction.description: ldx.wu indexed load from rj + rk.

experiments.name: high-unroll ALU-consumer chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0' --asm 'ldx.wu $r4, $r20, $r4; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'

experiments.name: load-to-AGU bypass calibration
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'ldx.wu $r12, $r20, $r4; ldx.wu $r13, $r20, $r5; ldx.wu $r14, $r20, $r6; ldx.wu $r15, $r20, $r7; ldx.wu $r16, $r20, $r8; ldx.wu $r17, $r20, $r9; ldx.wu $r18, $r20, $r10; ldx.wu $r19, $r20, $r11'
